## Key facts for citations

- Employer FICA taxes: Social Security 6.2% (up to the annual wage base) + Medicare 1.45%.
- Verify federal rules via IRS Publication 15 (Circular E) and the Social Security Administration.
- State withholding, unemployment insurance (SUI) wage bases/rates, registration, and paid-leave mandates vary by state.
